description_good_justification: The README opens with what the site does: it shows design tokens and how they relate, each token a pill and each alias a line: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/README.md
interact_justification: The README links the live site and explains how to run it; the contributing guide explains how to ask questions, report bugs (GitHub issues) and contribute: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
contribution_justification: The contribution process (issues, pull requests, required checks, sign-off): https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#contributing-code
contribution_requirements_justification: Requirements for contributions, including coding style, tests, token files, dependencies and the DCO: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#contributing-code
documentation_basics_justification: The README describes the site, links it, and shows how to run and build it; the contributing guide describes its architecture and every script: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/README.md#development
documentation_interface_justification: The site's interface is its two pages, linked from the README, and the design token files it reads, DTCG 2025.10 plus this tool's $extensions, documented with the token reader's public API in the src/tokens README: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/src/tokens/README.md#public-api
sites_https_justification: The repository and the site are served over HTTPS; GitHub Pages enforces HTTPS for the site, and HTTP redirects to it: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow and https://phun-ky.net/site-design-token-flow/
discussion_justification: GitHub issues and pull requests are searchable, addressable by URL and open to anyone with a GitHub account: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/issues
english_justification: All documentation is in English, and reports and comments in English are accepted.
maintained_justification: The project is actively maintained: changes are merged and deployed in November 2026: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Amerged
repo_track_justification: Git records who changed what and when: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/commits/main
repo_interim_justification: Every change is a public commit and pull request; there are no separate releases, main is what is deployed.
version_unique_justification: The site is continuously delivered: every merge to main is deployed, and each deployed version is identified by its git commit ID, which GitHub Pages records for every deployment: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/deployments
version_semver_justification: The site doesn't use version numbers: it is a single website, continuously delivered, so each deployed version is identified by its git commit instead. As the criterion's rationale notes, SemVer adds little for such a site.
version_tags_justification: Each deployed version is a commit on main, identified in git; GitHub records each GitHub Pages deployment against that commit: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/deployments
release_notes_justification: The site is a single website, not reused in multiple places, and is continuously delivered: every merge to main is deployed. Each change is described in its pull request: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Amerged
release_notes_vulns_justification: Everyone always runs the latest version: the site is a single website, continuously delivered, so there are no versions to choose between or update. A fixed vulnerability would be described in a GitHub security advisory.
report_responses_justification: Every issue is assigned to the maintainer when it is opened. No one outside the project has filed a bug report in the last 12 months, so none is unanswered.
enhancement_responses_justification: Enhancement requests are answered in their GitHub issue. No one outside the project has filed one in the last 12 months, so none is unanswered.
report_archive_justification: All issues and pull requests stay public and searchable on GitHub: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/issues?q=is%3Aissue
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: Private reports through GitHub private vulnerability reporting or by email: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/SECURITY.md#reporting-a-vulnerability
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No vulnerability has been reported in the last 6 months. Reports are acknowledged within 7 days: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/SECURITY.md#how-reports-are-handled
build_justification: npm run build builds the site with Vite into dist/, adding the Content Security Policy to every page: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#development
build_common_tools_justification: npm, Vite and the TypeScript compiler.
build_floss_tools_justification: npm, Node.js, Vite and TypeScript are all FLOSS.
test_justification: Unit tests with Node's test runner (npm test), and Playwright checks of the built site in Google Chrome (npm run test:e2e): network, layout, links, behaviour and performance budgets: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests
test_invocation_justification: npm test, the standard way to run tests in an npm project; npm run test:e2e for the checks of the built site.
test_most_justification: The source is at 88% of lines, 93% of branches and 97% of functions; npm run test-ci fails below 85% of lines, 90% of branches or 97% of functions, and coverage is uploaded to Codecov from every CI run. The Playwright checks cover both pages and the 404 page in both themes.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: The Checks workflow lints, checks formatting, type-checks, runs the unit tests with coverage and builds the site, and the Website checks job runs the Playwright checks against the build, on every pull request and every push to main: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/.github/workflows/check.yml
test_policy_justification: New functionality must come with tests and bug fixes with a regression test: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests
tests_are_added_justification: Recent changes came with tests: token value validation (#64) and reference checks (#68) with unit tests, font loading (#59) with tests and a data check of every font file, keyboard controls (#73) with unit tests, and the Playwright checks of the built site (#79).
tests_documented_added_justification: The tests policy is part of the instructions for contributing code: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests
warnings_justification: TypeScript in strict mode, and ESLint (typescript-eslint, stylistic, Markdown and import rules) on every file, Markdown included.
warnings_fixed_justification: Lint has no errors and no warnings, and TypeScript has no errors; CI fails on either.
warnings_strict_justification: TypeScript runs with strict: true, and CI runs ESLint with --max-warnings=0, so a warning fails the Checks workflow.
know_secure_design_justification: The maintainer knows how to design secure software. The principles applied: no server, accounts or stored data; a Content Security Policy that allows only the site's own scripts, styles, images and fonts; token values validated against their $type and escaped for HTML and CSS; nothing loaded from other hosts; least-privilege CI tokens, pinned Actions, and deploys only of commits that passed the checks. What the site guarantees and does not: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
know_common_errors_justification: The maintainer knows the common errors for this kind of software: cross-site scripting (values are escaped, a Content Security Policy without unsafe-inline scripts), CSS injection through untrusted data (token values validated, font names escaped, #31), loading from other hosts (blocked by the policy and checked in CI), prototype pollution (lookups by own properties only), and supply chain (locked and reviewed dependencies, a 14-day cooldown, pinned Actions): https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/SECURITY.md#content-security-policy
crypto_published_justification: The site implements and calls no cryptography: it is static HTML, CSS and JavaScript that draw design tokens in the browser, with no accounts, secrets or server. HTTPS is provided by GitHub Pages. See the security expectations: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations

HTTPS is provided by GitHub Pages. See the security expectations: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
crypto_random_justification: The site generates no keys, nonces or other security values. See the security expectations: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
delivery_mitm_justification: The site is served only over HTTPS by GitHub Pages, with HTTPS enforced, and deployed from GitHub Actions; the repository is served over HTTPS and SSH.
delivery_unsigned_justification: No hashes are fetched over HTTP; npm verifies the integrity hashes in package-lock.json against packages downloaded over HTTPS.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: The site's runtime dependencies have no known vulnerabilities (npm audit --omit=dev). Development dependency advisories are fixed or recorded as accepted exceptions, with why they don't affect the site and a date to remove them, as the security policy describes: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/SECURITY.md#dependencies
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: No critical vulnerability has been found in the site or its runtime dependencies.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: No credentials are in the repository; GitHub secret scanning with push protection is enabled: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/SECURITY.md#secrets
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL (GitHub default setup) analyses every pull request and push to main, for the TypeScript code and the workflows, and ESLint runs on every pull request.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL analyses the JavaScript and TypeScript code and the GitHub Actions workflows on every push to main and every pull request, and the ruleset on main requires its results, with no errors and no high or critical security alerts, before merging: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/SECURITY.md#code-scanning
static_analysis_fixed_justification: CodeQL has no open alerts; the ruleset blocks merging with a high or critical one.
static_analysis_often_justification: On every pull request and every push to main.
dynamic_analysis_justification: An automated test suite with more than 80% branch coverage (93%) runs on every pull request and push to main, so before every deploy, and the Playwright checks run the built site in Chrome with varied input: both themes, three widths, keyboard, wheel and pointer input, and invalid token JSON: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: All software is TypeScript on JavaScript runtimes, which are memory-safe; there is no C, C++ or other memory-unsafe code.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: The tests assert on every result, and the site checks untrusted input at run time: every token value is validated against its $type, throwing TypeError or RangeError, also in production; the Playwright checks fail on any console error or Content Security Policy violation.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: No medium or higher severity vulnerability has been found by the tests. CSS injection through token values, found in an audit of the site (#31), was fixed with tests (#64).
achieve_passing_justification: The project has the passing badge: https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/16376
dco_justification: Every commit must be signed off under the Developer Certificate of Origin, checked on every pull request by the DCO app and required by the ruleset on main: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#developer-certificate-of-origin
governance_justification: The maintainer-led governance model and how decisions are made: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md
roles_responsibilities_justification: The maintainer and contributor roles and their responsibilities, and who holds them: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#roles
access_continuity_justification: One maintainer holds the access to the repository, the site and its domain today. Deploys use no personal token and the code is MIT-licensed, but no second person holds access yet: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#continuity
bus_factor_justification: The project has one maintainer, so the bus factor is 1: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/graphs/contributors
documentation_roadmap_justification: What the project plans to do, consider and not do until November 2027, linking the issues: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/ROADMAP.md
documentation_architecture_justification: The pages, the flow view, the site code, the token reader, the build plugin and the checks: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#architecture
documentation_security_justification: What visitors can and cannot rely on: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
documentation_quick_start_justification: How to use the flow view and the playground, with nothing to install: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/README.md#using-the-site
documentation_current_justification: Documentation is changed in the same pull request as the behaviour it describes, and defects in it are fixed as normal changes. CI checks that every file and heading linked from .bestpractices.json and security-insights.yml exists, the README and the contributing guide are linted with ESLint, and the security policy was brought up to date with the repository settings in the pull request for this answer.
documentation_achievements_justification: The README shows the OpenSSF Best Practices and Scorecard badges: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/README.md
accessibility_best_practices_justificati: Both pages have a skip link, landmarks and headings, a focusable canvas with documented keys for panning and zooming, labelled controls, visible focus, and no transitions with reduced motion. axe-core (WCAG 2.0, 2.1 and 2.2 A and AA, plus best practice) reported no violations on either page in either theme, and the light theme colours were raised to meet contrast: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/pull/73
internationalization_justification: The site is in English only. Its text is in the HTML pages and the TypeScript that builds the interface, not in message files, so translating it would mean changing the code. Token names and values come from the token files and are shown as they are.
sites_password_security_justification: The project sites (GitHub and a static site on GitHub Pages) store no passwords for external users; the site has no accounts.
maintenance_or_update_justification: There is one version, the live site: every visitor gets the current one, so there is no older version to maintain or upgrade from. The deprecated npm package @phun-ky/design-token-flow is marked deprecated on npm: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/SECURITY.md#supported-versions
vulnerability_report_credit_justificatio: No vulnerabilities have been reported to the project in the last 12 months; the repository has no security advisories: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/security/advisories
vulnerability_response_process_justifica: Reports are made privately through GitHub private vulnerability reporting or by email. Acknowledgement within 7 days, assessment, a fix in a draft GitHub security advisory, disclosure once deployed, and credit: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/SECURITY.md#how-reports-are-handled
coding_standards_justification: Code follows the project ESLint configuration (eslint-config-phun-ky), Prettier and TypeScript in strict mode, and must pass npm run lint, npm run format:check and npm run typecheck: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#coding-style
coding_standards_enforced_justification: The Checks workflow runs ESLint with no warnings allowed, Prettier and the TypeScript compiler in strict mode on every pull request, and the ruleset on main requires it to pass before merging.
build_standard_variables_justification: No native binaries are built; Vite compiles TypeScript and CSS into the static site.
build_preserve_debug_justification: The build keeps source maps (build.sourcemap in vite.config.ts), deployed next to the minified scripts, so stack traces and debuggers map to the original TypeScript.
build_non_recursive_justification: npm run build runs vite build once, with one configuration that builds both pages; nothing builds recursively.
build_repeatable_justification: Dependencies are locked in package-lock.json and installed with npm ci; building the same commit twice gives identical output, and a local build of main (287f7a5) matched the files deployed to GitHub Pages byte for byte.
installation_common_justification: The site is a website: nothing is installed or uninstalled. Visitors open it in a browser.
installation_standard_variables_justific: The site is a website: nothing is installed, so there are no installation locations to honour.
installation_development_quick_justifica: git clone, npm ci and npm run dev give the full development environment, and npm test and npm run test:e2e run the checks: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#development
external_dependencies_justification: The runtime libraries (@phun-ky/arclace and shiki) and the development dependencies are listed in package.json and locked in package-lock.json; the vendored IBM Plex Sans fonts, their source and their licence are documented: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/SECURITY.md#dependencies
dependency_monitoring_justification: Dependabot checks npm dependencies and GitHub Actions weekly and opens security updates at once, and dependency review checks every pull request: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/SECURITY.md#dependencies
updateable_reused_components_justificati: Dependencies come from npm through package.json and the lockfile, and Dependabot opens update pull requests. The only copied files are the IBM Plex Sans fonts, whose source packages, versions and update steps are documented: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/SECURITY.md#dependencies
interfaces_current_justification: The code uses current interfaces: ES modules, the CSS Font Loading API, ResizeObserver, Vite 8, TypeScript in strict mode, Node 24 in CI, and current GitHub Actions pinned to commit SHAs.
automated_integration_testing_justificat: The Checks workflow lints, type-checks, runs the unit tests with coverage and builds the site on every pull request and push to main, and the Website checks run Playwright against the built site in Chrome: requests, layout, links, the flow view, the playground and performance budgets: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/.github/workflows/check.yml
regression_tests_added50_justification: Five of the seven bug fixes in the last six months came with a test that fails without them (wrapped pill widths, the pill width cap, referenced token types, the fitted zoom and value validation); the two others fixed CI and a maintainer script.
test_statement_coverage80_justification: Line coverage of the source (tests and types excluded), measured with Node built-in coverage on every CI run and uploaded to Codecov, is 88%. test-ci fails below 85% of lines, 90% of branches or 97% of functions.
test_policy_mandated_justification: New functionality must come with tests and bug fixes with a regression test: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests
implement_secure_design_justification: Secure design principles applied (economy of mechanism, fail-safe defaults, least privilege, complete mediation, open design, no dynamic code, minimal dependencies): https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/ASSURANCE.md#secure-design-principles
crypto_algorithm_agility_justification: The site implements and calls no cryptography and makes no network requests of its own; it is served by GitHub Pages over HTTPS. See the security expectations: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
crypto_credential_agility_justification: The site implements and calls no cryptography and makes no network requests of its own; it is served by GitHub Pages over HTTPS. See the security expectations: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
crypto_used_network_justification: The site implements and calls no cryptography and makes no network requests of its own; it is served by GitHub Pages over HTTPS. See the security expectations: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
crypto_tls12_justification: The site implements and calls no cryptography and makes no network requests of its own; it is served by GitHub Pages over HTTPS. See the security expectations: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
crypto_certificate_verification_justific: The site implements and calls no cryptography and makes no network requests of its own; it is served by GitHub Pages over HTTPS. See the security expectations: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
crypto_verification_private_justificatio: The site implements and calls no cryptography and makes no network requests of its own; it is served by GitHub Pages over HTTPS. See the security expectations: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
signed_releases_justification: There are no releases: the site is continuously delivered from main to GitHub Pages, and nothing is distributed for anyone to download or install: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#deploys
version_tags_signed_justification: There are no releases and no tags: each deployed version is a commit on main. Commits are not signed.
input_validation_justification: Every token value is checked against an allowlist for its $type as DTCG 2025.10 defines it (numbers, units, hex colours, colour components in range, keywords from the spec's lists), and token and group properties against the spec, before anything is shown; a token file that fails is refused with an error naming the token and the field: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/src/tokens/utils/validate-token.ts
hardening_justification: A Content Security Policy that allows only the site's own scripts, styles, images and fonts, no-referrer, strict TypeScript, values validated against allowlists and escaped for HTML and CSS, no eval or dynamic code, read-only CI permissions with SHA-pinned actions, CodeQL on every pull request: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/SECURITY.md#content-security-policy
assurance_case_justification: What is protected, the threat model, trust boundaries, secure design principles, the common weaknesses countered and the known gaps: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/ASSURANCE.md
osps_ac_01_01_justification: The maintainer, the only person with access, uses two-factor authentication on GitHub, which GitHub requires for code contributors. Anyone given access later must use it too: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#becoming-a-maintainer
osps_ac_02_01_justification: GitHub requires a role to be chosen for every collaborator invited to the repository, and the governance requires the lowest role that fits: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#becoming-a-maintainer
osps_ac_03_01_justification: The ruleset on main requires changes to arrive through a pull request with passing checks; only the maintainer, as administrator, can bypass it.
osps_ac_03_02_justification: A separate ruleset on main, with no bypass, blocks deleting the branch and force pushes.
osps_br_01_01_justification: No workflow interpolates untrusted metadata, such as pull request titles or branch names, into a script; the commit the Deploy workflow checks is passed through an environment variable: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/.github/workflows/deploy.yml
osps_br_01_03_justification: Pull requests run on the pull_request event, where forks get no secrets. The labeler runs on pull_request_target but never checks out or runs pull request code, with only pull-requests: write. The site deploys only from main, after a merge.
osps_br_03_01_justification: All official channels use HTTPS: the GitHub repository and the site at https://phun-ky.net/site-design-token-flow/, where GitHub Pages enforces HTTPS.
osps_br_03_02_justification: The site, the only thing distributed, is served only over HTTPS by GitHub Pages, and HTTP redirects to it: https://phun-ky.net/site-design-token-flow/
osps_br_07_01_justification: GitHub secret scanning with push protection is enabled and blocks commits that contain secrets; secrets are kept only in GitHub Actions secrets: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/SECURITY.md#secrets
osps_do_01_01_justification: How to use the flow view and the playground: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/README.md#using-the-site
osps_do_02_01_justification: How to report a bug, with an issue template: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#reporting-bugs
osps_gv_02_01_justification: Proposed changes and usage problems are discussed in public GitHub issues and pull requests: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/issues
osps_le_02_01_justification: The source code is under the MIT licence, which is OSI-approved: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/LICENSE
osps_le_02_02_justification: The deployed site is under the MIT licence, which is OSI-approved; the IBM Plex Sans fonts it serves are under the SIL Open Font License 1.1, also OSI-approved: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/LICENSE
osps_le_03_01_justification: The licence is in the LICENSE file at the repository root: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/LICENSE
osps_le_03_02_justification: Each deployed version is a commit on main, whose source includes the LICENSE file; the fonts' licence is deployed next to them in fonts/LICENSE.txt: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/site/public/fonts/LICENSE.txt
osps_qa_01_02_justification: The full git history, with authors and dates, is public: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/commits/main
osps_qa_02_01_justification: The runtime and development dependencies are listed in package.json, with every version locked in package-lock.json; the vendored fonts are documented: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/package.json
osps_qa_04_01_justification: The project has a single repository.
osps_qa_05_01_justification: No generated executables are committed: the build output (dist) is ignored, and the site is built in CI.
osps_qa_05_02_justification: The only binary files are images (the icons and the social card) and the IBM Plex Sans font files, no executables. The fonts are copies from npm packages, checked against the registry's integrity hashes, with their source documented: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/SECURITY.md#dependencies
osps_vm_02_01_justification: Security contacts (email and GitHub private vulnerability reporting): https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/SECURITY.md#reporting-a-vulnerability
osps_ac_04_01_justification: Every workflow sets read-only permissions at the top level, and jobs ask only for what they need: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/.github/workflows/check.yml
osps_br_02_01_justification: The site is continuously delivered: each deployed version is identified by its git commit ID, which GitHub records for every GitHub Pages deployment: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/deployments
osps_br_04_01_justification: Every deployment is a merge of one pull request, whose description says what changed and how to test it; security fixes are described in GitHub security advisories: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Amerged
osps_br_05_01_justification: Dependencies are installed with npm ci from the lockfile in every pipeline, and the Deploy workflow installs them fresh, without a cache: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/.github/workflows/deploy.yml
osps_br_06_01_justification: The site is not distributed as assets anyone downloads or installs: browsers load it from GitHub Pages over HTTPS, deployed only by the Deploy workflow from main. Signed provenance and an SBOM will come with the token renderer once it is its own npm package: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/ROADMAP.md#the-pill-renderer-as-its-own-package
osps_do_06_01_justification: How dependencies are chosen, obtained, tracked and fixed: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/SECURITY.md#dependencies
osps_gv_01_01_justification: Who has access to the repository, the site and its domain: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#continuity
osps_gv_01_02_justification: The maintainer and contributor roles and their responsibilities: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#roles
osps_gv_03_02_justification: Requirements for code contributions: style, tests, token files, dependencies, sign-off, commits and pull requests: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#contributing-code
osps_le_01_01_justification: Every commit must carry a Developer Certificate of Origin sign-off, checked on every pull request by the DCO app and required by the ruleset on main: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#developer-certificate-of-origin
osps_qa_03_01_justification: The ruleset on main requires the status checks (check, dependency-review and DCO) and CodeQL results to pass before merging; only an administrator can bypass it.
osps_qa_06_01_justification: The Checks workflow builds the site and runs the unit tests and the Playwright checks on every pull request; the check job must pass before merging: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/.github/workflows/check.yml
osps_sa_01_01_justification: The architecture (the pages, the flow view, the site code, the token reader, the build plugin and the checks): https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#architecture
osps_sa_02_01_justification: The site's external interfaces are its two pages, described in the README, and the design token files it reads, DTCG 2025.10 plus this tool's $extensions, documented with the token reader's public API: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/src/tokens/README.md#public-api
osps_sa_03_01_justification: The assurance case assesses the most likely and impactful security problems: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/ASSURANCE.md
osps_vm_01_01_justification: Coordinated disclosure, with acknowledgement within 7 days and a fix within 30 days for serious issues: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/SECURITY.md#how-reports-are-handled
osps_vm_03_01_justification: Private reporting through GitHub private vulnerability reporting or the security email: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/SECURITY.md#reporting-a-vulnerability
osps_vm_04_01_justification: Vulnerabilities are published as GitHub security advisories once fixed and deployed: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/SECURITY.md#how-reports-are-handled
osps_ac_04_02_justification: Each job declares only the permissions it needs, for example the deploy job pages: write and id-token: write, the labeler pull-requests: write, the failure notifications issues: write: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/.github/workflows/deploy.yml
osps_br_01_04_justification: The workflows take no manual inputs, and the only collaborator-controlled value used in a script, the commit the Deploy workflow checks, is passed through an environment variable and only compared: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/.github/workflows/deploy.yml
osps_br_02_02_justification: Each deployment is recorded by GitHub against its commit, and its Pages artifact is built from that commit in that run: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/deployments

osps_gv_04_01_justification: Collaborators are reviewed, including two-factor authentication, before getting escalated permissions: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#becoming-a-maintainer

osps_qa_04_02_justification: The project has a single repository, so there are no subprojects in other repositories.
osps_qa_06_02_justification: When and how the tests run, locally and in CI: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests
osps_qa_06_03_justification: New functionality and bug fixes must come with tests: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests
osps_qa_07_01_justification: The project has one maintainer, so no non-author approval is possible yet. A review by a maintainer other than the author is required once there is a second maintainer: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#reviews
osps_sa_03_02_justification: Threat model, trust boundaries and attack surface: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-design-token-flow/blob/main/ASSURANCE.md#threat-model
